subscription_choice.description: Whether deletion keeps the paid subscription so it becomes reusable after deletion completes, or cancels it at the provider. Omission safely keeps the subscription.

agent_id.title: Agent Id
agent_id.description: Authoritative stable Cloud Agent identity for this deployment and runtime. It is available independently of Cloud projection state.

current_plan_slug.title: Current Plan Slug

provider_conflicts.title: Provider Conflicts
provider_conflicts.description: Clawdi AI providers the current runtime did not apply because its native Hermes/OpenClaw configuration already owns them. Populated only while the deployment serves with a current-generation advisory Degraded condition (reason ProviderConflict or RuntimeUiUnavailable).

V2HostedProviderConflict.title: V2HostedProviderConflict
V2HostedProviderConflict.description: A Clawdi AI provider the runtime skipped to keep its native configuration.

breakdown_limit.title: Breakdown Limit
breakdown_limit.description: Maximum rows returned for each agent or model breakdown.

context_window.title: Context Window
context_window.description: Baseline context window available on the managed surface.

max_context_window.title: Max Context Window
max_context_window.description: Optional conditional upper bound. Clients must qualify this value instead of presenting it as guaranteed capacity.

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: Authoritative full display name copied verbatim from the bundled Hosted model catalog.

provider_id.title: Provider Id
provider_id.description: Canonical provider identifier from the bundled Hosted model catalog.

api_mode.title: Api Mode
api_mode.description: Optional model-specific protocol override. Null means the model inherits the managed provider protocol.

description.title: Description
description.description: Authoritative single-sentence choice guidance from the curated Hosted managed catalog.

capabilities.description: Factual metadata from the bundled Hosted model catalog.

funding.title: Funding
funding.description: Actual payment source: wallet, usdc, a Stripe payment method type, multiple, or unknown when evidence is missing. Null means no user payment.
